description: Purpose: run a fresh, read-only teardown of a public website's money path (landing page, call to action, lead form, checkout reachability, analytics) and report where revenue is leaking, with dollar proof. When to use: the user gives a website address and asks whether the site is losing leads or sales, why a form or checkout may be broken, or for a free revenue audit of a site; this is the entry point for any site not yet checked. Inputs: url (required, a public website address); api_key (optional, lifts the free daily limit). Outputs: runId and a proof object with findings, each labelled confirmed (reproduced from outside), likely (inferred from the public page) or unverifiable from outside, plus a conservative monthly dollar floor on confirmed or likely findings. Limits: free and needs no key for a single check; sees only what a visitor sees; never submits a form and never completes a charge; cannot see inside a private dashboard or a payment processor account.

api_key.description: Optional. A Smoke Run API key. It lifts the free daily limit and is not required for a single check.

url.description: A public website address, for example https://example.com.

name: run_revenue_check

dollarsAtRisk.description: Conservative monthly floor, summed from confirmed and likely findings only.

findingCount.description: Total findings, which can exceed the number returned in findings.

confidence.description: confirmed: reproduced from outside. likely: inferred from the public page. unverifiable_from_outside: only a connected check can confirm it; carries no dollar figure.

estMonthlyLoss.description: Conservative monthly dollar floor. Present only on confirmed or likely findings.

whatBroke.description: Plain-English statement of what is wrong.

where.description: Where on the money path it was seen.

proof.description: Keyed callers only. The dollar proof: siteUrl, headline, dollarsAtRisk, window, findings, generatedAt.

runId.description: Keyed callers only. The stored check id, readable later with get_latest_findings, list_checks or GET /api/v1/checks/{id}.

status.description: inconclusive means the scan could not finish; it carries no findings, no dollar figure and says nothing about whether the money path works.

window.description: The period the dollar figure covers, for example "per month".
